Name: Junimo Kart Anywhere
Author: MartyrPher
Description:
[size=6][b]Lets you play Junimo Kart Anywhere![/b][/size]

With Stardew Valley 1.4 and JKA 1.1.0 you can now,
[list]
[*]Choose a specific level from the [code]progress mode[/code] levels
[*]Play the old version of Junimo Kart from Stardew Valley 1.3
[/list][size=5][b]How To Use
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Press ﻿J to play Junimo Kart!
[/list][b][size=5]Config Options
[/size][/b][list]
[*][code]"StartGameKey": "SButton" [/code]Default: [code]J[/code]. SButton being any from this [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]list.[/url]﻿
[*][code]"ChooseLevel": "bool"[/code] Default: false. Set to [code]true[/code] to be able to choose a specific level from progress mode.
[*][code]"OldVersion": "bool"[/code] Default: false. Set to [code]true[/code] to be able to play the old Junimo Kart.
